root.mailSubject: Modificaiton of leave Application for <%leaveSeekerName%> from <%previousStartDate%>- <%previousEndDate%> to <%startDate%>-<%endDate%>
root.mailContent:
Dear <%leaveSeekerName%>,

The following email is sent to <%approverName%>


---------------



Dear <%approverName%>,


A Leave request awaiting approval, has been modified with the following details


Details of the Leave requested previously:



Employee Name: <%leaveSeekerName%>


Leave Duration: <%previousStartDate%> to <%previousEndDate%>


Total Days: <%previousNumberOfDays%>


Reason for Leave:<%previousDescription%>



Details of the Modified Leave request:


Employee Name: <%leaveSeekerName%>


Leave Duration: <%startDate%> to <%endDate%>


Total Days: <%numberOfDays%>


Reason for Leave:<%description%>



Work Handover:


<%colleagueName%> will be handling my duties during my absence and can be reached at <%colleagueEmail%>/<%colleagueContact%> for any urgent matters.


Should there be any emergencies or if further clarification is needed, I can be reached at <%contactPhone%>.


<%assistLogo%>
Assist Leave Notification.
